detailed_descriptions.en: FAKE ME combines classic hide-and-seek with creative 3D modeling in an online multiplayer game. Split into two teams: Fakers and Seekers. Fakers must blend into the environment and avoid being caught until time runs out, while Seekers must spot the objects created by other players and find every Faker. BUILD YOUR OWN DISGUISE Use simple and easy-to-use modeling tools to build the object you want to hide as from scratch. Model a single shape or combine multiple pieces to create anything you can imagine, from a small decoration to a large structure. BLEND INTO THE ENVIRONMENT Choose the right size, colors, and position to make your creation look like a natural part of the map. Build a convincing prop or try an unusual disguise designed to confuse the Seekers. FIND ANYTHING SUSPICIOUS An extra chair, a strangely shaped box, or a structure you are certain was not there a moment ago could be another player. Find every Faker before time runs out. DESIGN YOUR OWN CHARACTER Modeling tools are not just for hiding. As a Seeker, you can customize your character’s appearance however you like. Paint your character and create unique costumes by modeling and combining different shapes. Create something funny and unusual or design a warrior with a style all your own. You decide what your character looks like. PROP PAINT MODE Instead of modeling from scratch, transform into an object on the map and paint it however you like. Blend into your surroundings—or stand out. It’s up to you! CHARACTER SKILLS Use different skills as a Faker or a Seeker. A well-timed move could help you hide, escape, or find an opponent. MODEL SAVING, LIBRARY & EXPORT Save your models to your library to view them later or export them for use in other programs. You can also share screenshots of your creations. SOUND WHEEL & VOICE RECORDING Choose funny sounds from the sound wheel or record your own voice. Add a little more chaos to hide-and-seek with your lines and impressions! A NEW IDEA IN EVERY MATCH Because players build their own models, no two rounds are ever exactly the same. Try new disguises, discover creative hiding spots, and create designs that will surprise your friends. Perfectly imitate the environment or build something ridiculous that makes everyone laugh. The best disguise is the one you create yourself.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FAKE ME combines classic hide-and-seek with creative 3D modeling in an online multiplayer game.

Split into two teams: Fakers and Seekers. Fakers must blend into the environment and avoid being caught until time runs out, while Seekers must spot the objects created by other players and find every Faker.

BUILD YOUR OWN DISGUISE

Use simple and easy-to-use modeling tools to build the object you want to hide as from scratch. Model a single shape or combine multiple pieces to create anything you can imagine, from a small decoration to a large structure.


BLEND INTO THE ENVIRONMENT

Choose the right size, colors, and position to make your creation look like a natural part of the map.

Build a convincing prop or try an unusual disguise designed to confuse the Seekers.


FIND ANYTHING SUSPICIOUS

An extra chair, a strangely shaped box, or a structure you are certain was not there a moment ago could be another player.

Find every Faker before time runs out.

DESIGN YOUR OWN CHARACTER

Modeling tools are not just for hiding. As a Seeker, you can customize your character’s appearance however you like.

Paint your character and create unique costumes by modeling and combining different shapes. Create something funny and unusual or design a warrior with a style all your own.

You decide what your character looks like.

PROP PAINT MODE

Instead of modeling from scratch, transform into an object on the map and paint it however you like. Blend into your surroundings—or stand out. It’s up to you!

CHARACTER SKILLS

Use different skills as a Faker or a Seeker. A well-timed move could help you hide, escape, or find an opponent.

MODEL SAVING, LIBRARY & EXPORT

Save your models to your library to view them later or export them for use in other programs. You can also share screenshots of your creations.

SOUND WHEEL & VOICE RECORDING

Choose funny sounds from the sound wheel or record your own voice. Add a little more chaos to hide-and-seek with your lines and impressions!

A NEW IDEA IN EVERY MATCH

Because players build their own models, no two rounds are ever exactly the same. Try new disguises, discover creative hiding spots, and create designs that will surprise your friends.

Perfectly imitate the environment or build something ridiculous that makes everyone laugh. The best disguise is the one you create yourself.
